we have developed a 89-item survey to measure the unmed needs of adult cancer survivorship.
we have developed a psychometrically sound instrument that is useful for determining unmet needs of cancer survivors.
a new instrument, the Survivors Unmet Need Survey (SUNS), was developed and tested for use in cancer survivorship research and practice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the unmet needs, and developing a valid and reliable measure of unmet needs of cancer survivors.

the development of a reliable, valid instrument to measure the needs of adult cancer patients and their families, and to provide the foundation for a national survey of unmet needs in the Australian population.
identifying and understanding the needs of adult cancer patients and their families, as well as developing and evaluating interventions to meet those needs.

the SUNS has high acceptability and is reliable and valid for use in cancer survivors.

the SUNS is a valid, reliable and useful measure of unmet needs for adult cancer survivors.

the SUNS is a reliable and valid instrument to measure the needs of cancer survivors.
